name: @sauce/swap
description: SauceScript swaps whose route a service builds when the program compiles: `kyberSwap` and `ecoSwap` on EVM chains, `jupiterSwap` and `ecoSwap` on Solana. Every compile is handed it as an ambient module, so a program calls them with no import. Each reads its route with `globalIn` from a module the SDK writes for it while the program compiles, and returns the amount of `tokenOut` the swap delivered to the Pot. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (swap.evm.js / swap.svm.js); there is no swap.js.
